Question Choices: A baker makes cakes c and pies p. At most 15 items can be made. Write the constraint.
Solution: Cake count plus pie count gives the total item count. At most/no more than includes the upper limit (<=); the requested constraint is c+p<=15. Object counts are nonnegative integers.

Question Choices: Each cake takes 2 hours and each pie takes 3 hours. At most 36 hours are available. Write the constraint. Let c count cakes and p count pies.
Hints: Multiply each count by its time.
Solution: Hours per cake times cake count plus hours per pie times pie count gives total work hours. At most/no more than includes the upper limit (<=); the requested constraint is 2c+3p<=36. Object counts are nonnegative integers.
